title: Noailles (Venice) to the Cardinal de Lorraine, 13 Nov 1558: BnF fr. 3151 no. 33

steps.what: Downloaded the Gallica volume fr. 3151 and located item 33 (views 60-61).

Found the court's decipherment in the inner margin beside each of the two cipher blocks on f. 60r; the binding hides the start of each gloss line ('... mauluaise ... gouvernement ... affaires'; '... grand seigneur ... ne luy ... de la fortune ...').

Split under the one-key rule (George Lasry, 14 Oct 2026): catalogue item 10 had grouped three letters in three different ciphers. La Guiche's 22-sign substitution stays in guiche1551; Noailles's Venice letter (another symbol alphabet) went to noailles1558 and Seure's six Lisbon letters (homophonic with numeral codes) to seure1558. The Noailles cipher itself was not transcribed or attacked.

Third cipher block (C, seven lines) found on f. 60v with a nearly complete decipherment of the time in the outer margin (Michael Brackx, issue #113; contributor step). Checked here on research/gallica_sweep/hi/k62.jpg (view 62): the block and the legible gloss lines are there. Extent corrected from two blocks, about 150 signs, to three blocks, 262 signs (his count).

Gloss readings on f. 60r corrected (Brackx, issue #113; contributor step), checked here on research/gallica_sweep/hi/k61_gloss.jpg: gloss A '...e pauur[ete]' and '[cond]uitte q[u'il] donne a', not 'gouvernement'; gloss B '[entre]prend sur luy et le' and 'de la Tou[ss]aint', not 'ne luy' and 'de la fortune'.

Key recovered from the three marginal glosses and a French 5-gram model (Montaigne): 246 of 262 tokens valued, 16 tentative; about 0.75 of words read on firm values (Brackx, issue #113; contributor step). Not reproduced here: no files attached; transcription, key, aligned decode and readings requested. His negative checks: fr. 3151 no. 14 in clear, Ribier II, fr. 20974 (31 Guise alphabets) none fits.

Brackx's crib_anneal.py (joint search of sign values and alignment with the marginal gloss) and lm_anneal.py (French 5-gram fill of free values), added to his gist on 28 Oct 2026 (revision d819ac655347), copied unchanged into brackx/ (MIT, credited). Not run here: lm_anneal.py needs numpy and a 5-gram table that is not in the gist, so the key recovery (246/262 valued in his first post) is still not reproduced.

outcome.method_basis: Contemporary marginal decipherments exist (f. 60r cut by the binding; f. 60v nearly complete); the cipher (three blocks, 262 signs) has not been transcribed or attacked here. A contributor reports a key from the glosses (issue #113), not yet reproduced, so no text is obtained yet.
outcome.fraction_read_source: Nothing transcribed or deciphered; the legible gloss words are not counted.
